backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend canister with CRUD operations for Chapter and PdfEntry types, storing data in in-memory Maps with auto-incrementing IDs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the hidden admin entry point in TermsPage.tsx was updated so the word 'Sia' appears as the last word of the last paragraph, styled to blend in, and navigates to /admin.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, serving as a build-planning reference for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes (backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, charts, sidebar) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML shell for the React SPA, setting up the viewport, PWA manifest link, Google Fonts (Inter and Poppins), and the #root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Study Sphere Pakistan, defining the app name, theme color, standalone display mode, and a single 256×256 icon.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker that caches static assets on install, cleans up old caches on activate, and serves a stale-while-revalidate strategy for same-origin GET requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app entry point that configures TanStack Router with all page routes, provides a QueryClient, wraps the app in DarkModeProvider, and controls the one-time splash screen via sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/AdminAuthGuard.t: Empty file — the AdminAuthGuard component has been removed and the file contains no code.
frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx: Audio player component that wraps an HTML5 audio element with play/pause, seek, and volume controls, resets state on URL change, and shows a graceful error UI with an external link fallback when the audio cannot load.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card for a chapter showing its title, available features (notes, audio, quiz, flashcards) as badges, and a completion checkmark if the chapter is marked done in storage.
frontend/src/components/ChapterForm.tsx: Provides a form for creating or editing a chapter, including fields for title, class, subject, URLs, quiz questions, and flashcards, with add/remove helpers and mutation hooks for saving.
frontend/src/components/ClassPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file indicating that the ClassPage component lives in the pages directory instead.
frontend/src/components/FlashcardSection: Displays an interactive flashcard deck with flip animation, previous/next navigation, and swipe gesture support for cycling through front/back card pairs.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, quick navigation links, legal disclaimer, copyright year, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top navigation header with logo, desktop nav links, dark mode toggle, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper that composes the Header, a main content area via React Router's Outlet, and the Footer.
frontend/src/components/NotesViewer.tsx: Embeds a notes URL (with Google Drive preview support) in an iframe, and handles missing URLs or load errors with fallback UI and an open-in-new-tab button.
frontend/src/components/PdfEntryForm.tsx: A form component for creating or editing a PDF entry (title, type, URL) that uses add/update mutations and renders a header with back navigation and a submit button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/QuizSection.tsx: A quiz UI component that steps through multiple-choice questions one at a time, tracks answers, and displays a score summary screen with a retry option when finished.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: A full-screen animated splash screen that displays the app logo and name for 2 seconds, then fades out and calls an onComplete callback.
frontend/src/contexts/DarkModeContext.ts: Provides a React context for dark mode state, persisting the preference via storageService and toggling the 'dark' class on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using TanStack Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using @dfinity/auth-client, exposing login/clear functions and status flags to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for all CRUD operations on chapters and PDF entries, each delegating to the backend actor obtained from useActor and invalidating relevant query caches on mutation success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter and Poppins fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes (including flashcard-specific variables), and implements the flashcard 3D flip animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabbed UI for managing chapters and PDF entries, supporting create, edit, and delete operations via mutation hooks and inline form components.
frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx: Detail page for a single chapter that displays tabs for audio, quiz, and flashcard sections, and tracks completion/recently-viewed state in local storage.
frontend/src/pages/ClassPage.tsx: Subject selection page for a given class number (9–12) that renders a grid of Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and English cards navigating to the corresponding subject route.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero section with a search bar, class/MDCAT navigation buttons, and a feature highlights grid showcasing notes, quizzes, flashcards, and more.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATPage.tsx: MDCAT preparation page that lists subject navigation cards and fetches/displays past papers and practice tests from the backend, with delete functionality via an alert dialog.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATSubjectPage.tsx: Displays chapters for a specific MDCAT subject, with search, recently viewed, and delete functionality, fetching data from the backend via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectPage.tsx: Displays chapters for a specific class/subject combination, with search, recently viewed, and delete functionality, similar in structure to MDCATSubjectPage but scoped by class number.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: A support/donation page that displays an Easypaisa account number with a copy-to-clipboard button and step-by-step instructions for sending money.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms & Conditions page with static sections covering educational use, affiliations, content changes, external links, and copyright, including a hidden admin navigation trigger.
frontend/src/types/chapter.ts: Defines the canonical frontend TypeScript interfaces for Chapter, PdfEntry, QuizQuestion, and FlashcardItem used throughout the UI.
frontend/src/utils/chapterMapper.ts: Provides mapper functions to convert backend Chapter and PdfEntry types (bigint IDs, JSON strings) into frontend-friendly types (string IDs, parsed arrays).
frontend/src/utils/jsonValidation.ts: Exports validation functions and example strings for quiz and flashcard JSON inputs, checking structure and field types before submission.
frontend/src/utils/storageService.ts: Manages device-local user data in localStorage, including recently viewed chapters, completed chapters, and dark mode preference.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode via class, custom CSS-variable-based color tokens, Inter/Poppins fonts, custom border radii, and accordion/fade/pulse keyframe animations with the tailwindcss-animate and @tailwindcss/typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document (version 25) describing Study Sphere Pakistan's architecture, features, and design decisions, including PWA setup, Motoko canister backend for chapter storage, admin panel access via hidden Terms & Conditions link, and the full list of implemented features.
